phát triển năng lực quản trị thương mại,: Develop commercial management capacity, analyze data and deploy business solutions in the digital environment, combining in-depth knowledge with practical business problems.

chương trình thạc sĩ kinh doanh thương m: The Master of Commerce program at Van Lang is designed with an the applied track, connecting management knowledge, customer behavior, marketing and digital technology. Students develop the ability to analyze contexts, make data-based decisions and implement solutions appropriate to business operations.
chương trình chú trọng quản trị kinh doa: The program focuses on digital business management, change leadership, marketing performance optimization and business research. Elective modules create opportunities to access ESG, artificial intelligence, omnichannel commerce, risk management, product innovation and data analysis.
dự án kinh doanh kết hợp chuyến đi thực: The business project combines a field trip, a graduation internship and a capstone project to help students apply knowledge to business situations, develop problem-solving skills and present well-founded solutions.
thực tập tốt nghiệp gắn với hoạt động ch: Graduation internship Associated with professional activities 6 credits
đề án tốt nghiệp giải quyết bài toán kin: Capstone Project Solving business problems 9 credits

học phần dự án kinh doanh kết hợp chuyến: The Business Project module combines a field trip to help students work with the real context and needs of businesses.
thực tập tốt nghiệp 6 tín chỉ và đề án t: The 6-credit graduation internship and the 9-credit capstone project facilitate applying knowledge, building solutions and demonstrating professional capacity.
bên cạnh các học phần, chương trình tạo: In addition to the modules, the program provides opportunities to participate in writing articles, attending seminars and discussing about commerce, marketing, e-commerce, international business and logistics. These activities support the process of formulating problems and implementing capstone projects.
mười chuẩn đầu ra bao quát kiến thức chu: Ten learning outcomes covering in-depth knowledge, analysis and solution implementation skills, along with autonomy and professional responsibility.

xét tuyển. hồ sơ được đánh giá theo điều: Admission is based on application assessment against the entry requirements of the Master of Commerce program.

chương trình đào tạo theo định hướng nào: Which Track Does the Program Offer?
chương trình thạc sĩ kinh doanh thương m: Applied Master of Commerce program, including 60 credits, standard duration of 24 months and 4-semester schedule. The content focuses on commercial management, digital business and solving practical business problems.
tôi cần đáp ứng điều kiện gì để dự tuyển: What conditions do I need to meet to apply?
ứng viên đã tốt nghiệp hoặc đủ điều kiện: Applicants must hold or be eligible to receive, a bachelor's degree or higher in an appropriate field and meet the foreign language entry requirements. Required bridging courses must be completed before admission assessment. Applications are reviewed according to University regulations and admissions announcements.
tốt nghiệp ngành khác có thể dự tuyển kh: Can I apply if I have graduated from another major?
ứng viên có ngành tốt nghiệp ngoài danh: Applicants whose previous field is not on the exemption list will have their applications reviewed to determine bridging requirements of up to 12 credits. The courses are Introduction to Economics, Principles of Management, Fundamentals of Marketing and Principles of Finance, each worth 3 credits.
phần tự chọn gồm hai nhóm, mỗi nhóm ba h: The elective section consists of two groups, each group has three modules. Students choose one course from semester 2 and one course from semester 3; each course is 4 credits, total 8 credits. Class opening is carried out according to the academic plan.
chương trình có thực tập và đề án tốt ng: Does the program have internships and capstone projects?
có. học kỳ 4 bố trí thực tập tốt nghiệp: Yes. Semester 4 arranges a 6-credit Graduation Internship and a 9-credit Capstone Project. Previously, semester 3 had a Business Project module combined with a field trip, helping students apply knowledge in a business context.
ngôn ngữ giảng dạy và yêu cầu ngoại ngữ: What is the language of instruction and foreign language requirements?
The program is taught in Vietnamese. Foreign language proficiency equivalent to Level 3 or above is required for admission and Level 4 or above for graduation under Vietnam's six-level foreign language proficiency framework. Accepted evidence is assessed according to University regulations and announcements.
lịch học có phù hợp với người đang đi là: Is the study schedule suitable for working people?
lịch học dự kiến bố trí vào buổi tối các: Class schedules are expected to be arranged in the evenings on weekdays and/or Saturdays and Sundays, according to each semester's plan. The official timetable is announced by the University. You can discuss with the Institute to arrange work, study time and project implementation.
học phí và chính sách hỗ trợ được áp dụn: How are tuition fees and support policies applied?
học phí toàn khóa là 85.000.000 đồng, ch: Total program tuition is VND 85,000,000, divided into three installments: VND 29,750,000, VND 25,500,000 and VND 29,750,000. Separate fees apply on a case-by-case basis. Scholarships and financial support are assessed according to University eligibility criteria, supporting documents and announcements; only the highest eligible benefit within the specified policy groups applies, with no combining of benefits.
